source.title: T.R.I. Advisory Circular No. PN 1 - The Suitability of Tea Clones for the Different Regions

general_guidance: Select at least 5-6 clones according to suitability for the particular location and extent.
No more than 10 percent of an estate should be under a single clone.
Clonal suitability can be tested by small-scale planting of at least 200 bushes.
Clones performing well in a particular locality, even if not listed in the circular, could be considered for planting in that locality.

assistant_rules: Use this knowledge as the primary source for questions about the provided T.R.I. circular.

Distinguish 'not specifically rated' from a negative rating such as low, poor, or unsuitable.
